newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Bank BICICI helps push Abidjan bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Bank BICICI helps push Abidjan bourse higher.

text.p: Share indices on the Abidjan bourse rose in the week to Friday, with Bank BICICI leading the way, the bourse's weekly market report showed.
The All-Share Index rose 0.42 percent to 395.36 points, taking the 1997 rise 10.5 percent. The index fell 1.09 percent in the previous week.
The 12 VB blue-chip index rose 0.5 percent to 270.07 points, taking the 1997 rise to 11.6 percent. The index shed 1.13 percent, the previous week.
BICICI rose 1,750 cedis to 35,850 cedis and retail and trading company PEYRISSAC rose 1,510 to 31,860 were the main risers.
Water utility SODECI fell 150 to 17,470 and maritime shipping SIVOM was down 150 to 18,550.
A total of 3,361 shares worth 75,387,245 CFA changed hands compared with 4,103 shares worth 69,462,270 CFA francs the previous week.
